annotations.title: Find a supplier in FDA records

description: Firms in the U.S. FDA's food records whose name matches, best first, each with its country, city, FDA establishment number (FEI), counts of FDA actions and its Supplier Brief page. Also finds a firm by its FEI number.

country.description: The supplier's country: a name such as 'India' or a two-letter code such as 'IN'.

name.description: The supplier's name as on its invoice, or its FEI number.
